# Dilemma v3.1.0

Plan where quizzes appear, browse the saved schedule and notify a role when a quiz starts.

- Set a destination with `channel` in `/dilemma create` and `/dilemma configure`. Scheduled quizzes and early `/dilemma run` publications use that destination.
- Configure independent random-quiz channels with `/dilemma random-channels add`, `remove` and `list`. An empty list permits random quizzes wherever the bot can publish polls; a nonempty list restricts every member to the selected channels.
- Browse every saved topic in the private `/dilemma list` card. Topics sort by configured start date and then name, with undated topics last. Filter by status, difficulty and channel, navigate five topics per page, refresh or clear the filters.
- Select a start notification role with `ping_role`, or remove it with `clear_ping:true`. Notifications apply to saved topics, including early manual runs. Random quizzes, configuration replies and result updates remain silent.
- Read clearer command summaries and updated help in all six supported languages.
- Update dependencies to remove the reported security advisories and audit them in CI. The configured AI model and generation limits remain unchanged.

Quizzes continue to use native Discord single-choice polls. Members can change or withdraw their vote until closing. Points use the final answer after Discord finalizes the poll. The two-randoms-per-day quota and eight-hour cooldown are unchanged.

Apply the additive `20261025120000_quiz_channels` and `20261025150000_quiz_ping_role` migrations, then re-register Discord commands. Existing topic destinations and scores are preserved; random channels initially remain unrestricted and start notifications remain disabled until configured.
